name: Coco Gauff
intro: Coco Gauff is one of America's favorite tennis stars. She grew up in Florida. She won this very tournament in 2023!
story: Coco's real name is Cori. Her dad played college basketball, and her mom ran track. They quit their jobs to help her dream. At 19 she won the US Open in front of a roaring crowd. In 2025 she won the French Open too.

funFacts.text: Her real first name is Cori. Everyone calls her Coco.
She has two little brothers named Codey and Cameron.
Her dream dinner is a burger, fries, and a brownie.
She does not like raw tomatoes. Too squishy!
She was homeschooled. As a teen she studied French.
She carried the American flag at the 2024 Paris Olympics. She was the youngest ever to do it.
At 16 she loved TikTok dances, ping-pong, and cornhole at home.

watchFor: Watch how fast she runs, chasing down balls nobody else could reach.

notes: Birth date, height, plays, started at six, parents' careers and quitting jobs, homeschooled, 2023 US Open at 19, 2025 French Open, youngest US flag bearer 2024 confirmed via Wikipedia; brothers Codey/Cameron via NBC Olympics; food facts via PureWow (Aug 28, 2026).
Wikipedia gives birthplace Boca Raton and residence Delray Beach (family moved there at age 7); hometown field kept as Delray Beach.
